Comment: borsuk complete original recovery SDK metadata roster only; no native

commands:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
r=/opt/borsuk-reconstruction-gate/parity-closed-recovery
prefix=research/semantic-router/20261011/reconstruction-real1m-a0001/retained-derived
export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS=1 AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=eu-central-1 AWS_PAGER=
while read -r sha name; do
 [[ $name == ./*.put.json ]] || continue
 [[ $sha =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ && $name =~ ^\./[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$ ]]
 f=$r/${name#./}
 printf '%s  %s\n' "$sha" "$f" | sha256sum -c -
 checksum=$(printf %s "$sha" | xxd -r -p | base64 -w0)
 timeout -k 2 10 aws s3api put-object --bucket borsuk-bench-453182569524-euc1 --key "$prefix/recovery-${name#./}" --body "$f" --if-none-match '*' --checksum-algorithm SHA256 --checksum-sha256 "$checksum" > /opt/borsuk-reconstruction-gate/sdk-completion-${name#./}.json
 jq -e --arg checksum "$checksum" '.ChecksumSHA256==$checksum' /opt/borsuk-reconstruction-gate/sdk-completion-${name#./}.json > /dev/null
done < "$r/SHA256SUMS"
printf 'ORIGINAL_SDK_RECEIPT_ROSTER_COMPLETED_NO_NATIVE\n'
